rule: LINGO-09 MR-50, MAC-31: the silent @reply tag. `options` is what both ReplyOptions.parse (Swift) and parseReplyOptions (TypeScript) return from the raw text; `spokenText` and `violations` are what the ordinary reply parser returns (an @reply line is never spoken, never a segment, never a violation); `hints` counts the @hint segments. Written by hand; checked by Swift ReplyOptionsTests and TypeScript reply-options.test.ts.

cases.name: three options with languages

options.text: Ich bleibe zu Hause und lese.

cases.name: missing and unknown language mean the study language
more than three keep the first three
malformed lines are skipped
empty translation is kept
cases.text:
@say de: Wie geht es Ihnen?
@reply de: Gut, danke. |

cases.name: list and bold markup and CRLF
a bar inside the translation stays in it
cases.text:
@say en: Which one?
@reply en: The red one. | Красный | тот, что слева.

cases.name: reasoning blocks are ignored
cases.text:
<think>@reply en: not this | не это</think>@say en: Ready?
@reply en: Yes, ready. | Да, готов.

cases.name: hint keeps its meaning next to reply
only reply lines leave no spoken text
